preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the string s is between 2 and 10^6.
The string s consists only of characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a length of a valid substring.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (count('a') > count('b') and count('a') > count('c')) for substring of length output[i] of s[i])
postconditions.description: For each valid output, the substring has 'a' occur strictly more times than 'b' and 'c'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or len(substring) >= 2) for substring in substrings of s
postconditions.description: For each valid output, the length of the substring is at least 2.
